meta.title: eFactory One — PRD Brief (Charter · Scope · Proposal)
meta.purpose: Structured source material for generating a Project Charter, Project Scope Statement, and Project Proposal. This file is optimized for those deliverables; detailed execution requirements, prototype matrices, and the full task backlog live in PRD.json at repo root.

pm_framework_notes.project_charter: Formal authorization to start; states purpose, measurable objectives, high-level scope/deliverables, key stakeholders and roles, summary schedule and budget envelope, known risks, sponsor sign-off. (Common practice aligns with PMI PMBOK-style charter content.)
pm_framework_notes.project_scope_statement: Defines what is in and out of scope: business justification, product/deliverable description at summary level, measurable project objectives, acceptance criteria themes, exclusions. Often expands charter scope into planning detail.
pm_framework_notes.project_proposal: Decision-oriented document for approval/funding: problem and context, proposed approach/solution, benefits and alignment, costs and resources, timeline, risks and mitigations, governance and success measures. May be more outward-facing than an internal charter.

executive_summary.one_line: Operator-centric order-to-payout platform for a German-first academic ghostwriting marketplace (DACH), replacing manual orchestration and Zapier while keeping Pipedrive as CRM system of record and Sevdesk as invoicing/legal accounting system of record.
executive_summary.business_driver: Consolidate intake from 17 WordPress Contact Form 7 surfaces, Sheets/Notion operational drift, Zapier→Pipedrive, Outlook, and WhatsApp into one controlled workflow with enforceable business rules and GW SOP alignment.
executive_summary.pm_assignment_note: Name a single accountable Project Manager for charter sign-off (may be tech lead, product owner, or dedicated PM).

non_negotiable_deadline.label: Zapier replacement / D-03
non_negotiable_deadline.meaning: Path that depends on Zapier→Pipedrive must be replaced by platform-native or direct integration flows before this date.

executive_summary.design_north_star: Order is the atomic unit; Admin is financial firewall, QA gate, assignment intelligence, dispute resolver; thin Customer and Ghostwriter (GW) surfaces — see docs/explorations/product_ux_workflow_discussion.md.

project_charter_inputs.purpose_and_justification: Eliminate fragmented tools and manual handoffs that create revenue leakage, inconsistent GW/customer experience, and integration brittleness; establish auditable workflow from inquiry through payout with external CRM and accounting truth lines preserved.
measurable_objectives: 100% of new intakes persist to platform database and Pipedrive without Zapier after cutover (from PRD.json success_metrics).
Single payment confirmation path: Stripe webhooks and manual mark-paid converge on one server-side confirmPayment semantics (D-06, D-07).
Honorarium release governed by documented five-gate Friday batch policy aligned to gw_workflow_sops and business_rules.
Order-centric unified communications model (D-11, D-17, D-18) ready for production email ingress (D-15) by M3 target.
project_charter_inputs.high_level_scope_description: Persisted multi-tenant application: customers, orders, 1:1 assignments, ghostwriters, payments (installments), submissions, QA, disputes, extensions; integrations with Pipedrive (phased), Sevdesk proposals/invoices, Stripe; WordPress webhook intake; communications layers as scoped in M2–M3; English-first UI with i18n-ready architecture (D-12, D-13).
key_deliverables_charter_level: Signed MVP scope and explicit out-of-MVP deferral list (M1 / blocker A-01).
Signed UX/Figma for Admin order spine, GW job board and submissions, customer portal, QA queue (D-04).
Integration contract pack: Pipedrive stage semantics (D-20), Sevdesk TextTemplates and API callers, Stripe metadata keys, Cloudflare inbound email authentication.
Staging end-to-end lifecycle per docs/INDEX.md six-step narrative with test Stripe and sandbox CRM/accounting (M2 exit).
Production cutover with Zapier decommission attestation and hypercare runbooks (M3).

authorization_and_governance.binding_decisions_source: docs/decisions_log.md — mirrored as confirmed_decisions_register in PRD.json (D-01 through D-20).
authorization_and_governance.gating_rule: D-04: No production application code until requirements and Figma are signed off.

summary_schedule.m1_theme: Scope, contracts, design lock — charter-ready baseline.
summary_schedule.m2_theme: Integrated platform build — staging lifecycle + Zapier functional parity.
summary_schedule.m3_theme: Communications production, cutover, hypercare — deadline 2026-07-31 for D-03.

summary_budget.charter_action: Attach approved budget envelope, contingency, and external subscription costs (Pipedrive tier, Stripe, Sevdesk, Cloudflare, WhatsApp/voice vendors if in scope).

charter_risks_top: Fixed cutover date vs design-first gate (D-03 vs D-04) compresses schedule.
Pipedrive subscriber cap (~4159/5000) risks campaign disruption (PP-01).
WhatsApp automation fragility and ToS risk if Option A–style paths chosen without acceptance.
NL→SQL BI (E-11) if rushed — injection and data exposure risk.

scope_statement_inputs.project_justification: Observable pain: manual orchestration across Google Sheets, Notion, 17 CF7 forms, Zapier→Pipedrive, Outlook, WhatsApp; need for operator-mediated control, German business rule fidelity, GW SOP traceability, and payment/legal consistency via Sevdesk + Stripe.
product_scope_inclusions: Webhook-based intake replacing Zapier for primary forms (see docs/source/wordpress_forms.md and PRD.json tasks).
Pipedrive mirroring and deal/person lifecycle per pipedrive.md phases 1–3.
Sevdesk saveOrder, proposal send, invoice-from-order, status changes per sevdesk.md.
Stripe with webhook authority and installment rules per payment_flow.md.
Admin pipeline (D-20 visibility rules), Friday batch release gates, disputes/revisions, extensions.
GW flows for SOPs 1–6, D, E per gw_sop_platform_mapping in PRD.json.
Customer portal thin surface and D-09 guest-to-account after acceptance/payment.
Cloudflare Email Worker inbound path (D-15); unified inbox model (D-17/D-18/D-19).
i18n-ready implementation (D-12/D-13); optional cash method if PM-01 approved.
product_scope_exclusions: Replacing Pipedrive or Sevdesk as systems of record (D-01, D-02).
Legal determination of ghostwriting market-by-market outside DE counsel scope.
Production-safe WhatsApp Web automation without explicit risk acceptance.
Voice call recording as product scope (D-16: metadata only if voice ships).
Multi-tab live-collaboration prototype behavior as production requirement.
Binding behavior to explorations E-* until promoted to decisions_log.
measurable_objectives_scope_level: Median time from paid to GW assignment within SLA stated in business_rules (quoted in PRD.json success_metrics).
GW SOP core path executable without WordPress form dependency for primary customer journey.
acceptance_criteria_themes: Lifecycle acceptance: INDEX.md six-step path demonstrable on staging with test payments and sandbox integrations (M2 exit_criteria).
Cutover acceptance: Zapier disabled with mapping attestation from old zaps to platform handlers (M3 exit_criteria).
Comms acceptance: order threads + person threads + mention notifications per D-17–D-19.
Operational acceptance: SLO dashboards for Stripe webhooks, Worker ingress, Pipedrive/Sevdesk error rates (M3).
constraints: Pipedrive API rate limit 100 requests / 10 seconds — queue and backoff required.
Platform is not the payment processor of record; marks paid via API after Stripe or admin confirmation.
Sevdesk sevUser and German template constraints per integrations doc.
Subscriber headroom and hygiene (PP-01) for campaigns.
D-04 design gate before production code.
assumptions: Sponsor remains available for GW selection approval where not automated (D-08).
Third-party APIs (Pipedrive, Sevdesk, Stripe) remain available with acceptable terms during build.
Flamingo historical CF7 data may remain Phase 0 quick win separate from main build (D-10) unless merged.

project_proposal_inputs.problem_statement: Same as PRD.json product_identity.problem_statement — fragmented toolchain and Zapier dependency before 2026-07-31.
project_proposal_inputs.proposed_solution: Greenfield platform with persisted workflow engine mirroring documented state semantics (see PRD.json prototype_state_machine as rehearsal only), server-enforced rules, integration layer, and phased communications unification.
benefits: Reduced manual error and revenue leakage across pricing, installments, and payout gates.
Auditable operator actions aligned to GW SOPs and German business rules.
Defensible integration architecture preserving CRM and accounting SoT.
Path to international expansion architecturally without blocking MVP (D-13).

stakeholder_benefits.sponsor_ops: Single console for order spine, pipeline, disputes, Friday batch.
stakeholder_benefits.ghostwriters: Clear claim, submission, extension, and payout rules.
stakeholder_benefits.customers: Thin portal; consistent comms proxy patterns.

costs_and_resources.proposal_action: Insert person-days or fixed-price phases mapped to M1–M3; list recurring SaaS fees and upgrade triggers (Pipedrive 5000 cap).

timeline_proposal_view.outcome: Charter-ready baseline; blockers closed or waived with dates; Figma sign-off; integration contracts documented.
Staging E2E; Zapier parity on intake and CRM writes; core GW/admin/customer/QA flows.
Production comms paths as approved; Zapier decommissioned by 2026-07-31; observability and runbooks.

management_approach.requirements_authority: docs/*.md per TC-04; PRD.json for backlog and traceability.
management_approach.quality_and_security: QA integration stance per PRD risks; webhook signature verification; read-only SQL or template BI if E-11 ships.
management_approach.change_control: Explorations E-* require graduation to decisions_log before binding scope changes.

project_proposal_inputs.competitive_or_alternatives_note: TBD for external proposal — describe build vs buy vs continued Zapier ops with quantified risk/cost if needed.
